Postfix puts the operator after its operands (3 4 +), prefix puts it before them (+ 3 4), and infix is the usual 3 + 4. Postfix (reverse Polish) needs no parentheses, which is why calculators and stack machines use it.

CALL shell: curl -sI https://api.example.test/v1/widgets/42 | grep -i etag (run twice and compare)
The ETag should change only when the representation changes, so a new value per request suggests a per-request variant such as a request id, a compression or language variant, or a generated field. Compare two back-to-back requests with the same headers to find which one. This response also carries a Sunset header for 30 June 2027, so the endpoint is on a deprecation path.
